items.title: Introduction
items.description: What Bevel UI is and how the copy-to-own model works.

items.title: Installation
items.description: Install any system with a single shadcn CLI command.

items.title: All Systems
items.description: Browse every Bevel UI system by category.

items.title: Product Tour
items.description: Guide users through your app with an animated overlay, smart-positioned tooltip cards, media support, and keyboard navigation.

items.title: Command Palette
items.description: ⌘K command menu with fuzzy search, two-tier tab filtering, grouped results, avatar support, and zero external dependencies.

items.title: Spotlight Search
items.description: Async content search with category tabs, recent history, and rich result cards. Triggered by / — distinct from Command Palette.

items.title: Form Engine
items.description: Multi-step or single-step form orchestration. Plugin system, react-hook-form + zod integration, conditional fields, custom layouts.

items.title: File Upload
items.description: Drag-and-drop file upload with per-file progress, cancel, retry, grid/list views, and a modal mode. Bring your own upload function.

items.title: Sortable
items.description: Headless drag-to-reorder system. Wrap any list, mark rows, optionally restrict drag to a handle. useSortableList manages the array.

items.title: Kanban
items.description: Multi-container drag-and-drop board with virtual state machine. Drag cards between columns, reorder columns, live placeholders during drag.

items.title: Properties Panel
items.description: Figma-style properties panel with collapsible sections, typed control rows, and a data-driven or headless API.

items.title: Resizable Panels
items.description: Split-pane layouts with smooth drag-to-resize, min/max constraints, and collapsible panels. Zero re-renders during drag.

items.title: Tree View
items.description: Recursive hierarchical data with expand/collapse, multi-select, full keyboard navigation, and optional connecting lines.

items.title: Media Gallery
items.description: A selectable media grid for images, video, audio, and documents. Multi-select, type filtering, keyboard-navigable lightbox, and drag-to-reorder.

items.title: Image Cropper
items.description: Dual coordinate spaces, eight-handle drag with aspect ratio enforcement, rule-of-thirds overlay, and offscreen canvas export at full image resolution.

items.title: Palette Editor
items.description: Visual color palette editor with a 2D HSV picker, sortable swatches, and one-click export to hex, CSS vars, Tailwind config, or HSL.

items.title: Collaborative Cursors
items.description: Real-time presence overlay with conflict-free position sync, idle detection, and a label overlap resolver that prevents names from stacking.

items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: A floating checklist widget with step dependencies, localStorage persistence, and animated expand/collapse.
